narrative:
Geauga County has 67,201 registered voters, with 53.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 14.5%, a pronounced Republican lean of 17.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 32.2% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -6.4% D−R vs -23.7% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
